_approach: A reverse-kick-style swell (tomLow slot, borrowed from the hard-dance vocabulary dariacore's hardstyle-kick lineage shares) doubling in density every half bar, growing under the plain four-on-the-floor hardstyle kick until both peak together on the last 16th with a crash. As with the kick-roll riser, this covers only the drum layer of a dariacore build — the actual tension in the genre usually comes from the sample's pitch/tempo edit riding alongside it.
